title: Patch: every finish shows on a full-art card
thread:
**Issue #2720 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #2720: Patch: every finish shows on a full-art card
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

## What it does

A finish (§14.2, R1295000) is the print of a card's face. Most of the finishes do their work on the face's **panel**, which a full-art face (R1017001) covers with its art, so on a full-art card they show little or nothing:

- Matte black ink, Brushed steel and Velvet recolour `--cf-frame`.
- Obsidian and Starlit paint `.cf-scale`.

Only the overlays on `.cf[data-finish]::before` reach the picture (`apps/web/src/cards/cosmetics.css`), and Stained glass alone has a full-art rule (`.cf:is([data-layout="minion"], [data-full-art="true"])[data-finish="finish-stained-glass"]::before`). A player who owns both a finish and a full art on a card therefore can't see the finish while the full art is worn.

Make every finish read clearly on a full-art face. For example, a finish that colours the panel can instead colour the full art's edge, the name banner's and the gems' plates, or lay its texture lightly over the picture, as Stained glass does. It must never hide the art, the Mythic's signature, the cost gem or a Unit's stats. This applies:

- to every non-default finish: `finish-parchment`, `finish-linen`, `finish-brushed-steel`, `finish-velvet`, `finish-matte-black-ink`, `finish-stained-glass`, `finish-gilded-edge`, `finish-obsidian` and `finish-starlit`;
- at every full-art tier (the Epic, Legendary and Mythic of R2655000, and #2715's new ones if that lands first);
- at hand, board-minion and inspect sizes.

The animated finishes (Gilded edge, Obsidian, Starlit) move on a full-art face as they do on a normal one: inside the motion gate, in a `COSMETIC_FOIL_ANIMATED_MAX` slot, and still under reduced motion or with Animated foil off.

This is presentation only (CLAUDE.md rule 7), so it takes a ruling note in this issue's block, or an amendment to R1295000. It changes how cards look, so a pending fragment claims it (a micro, R2529000).

## Acceptance

- For each of the nine finishes, a component (pixel) spec shows a full-art face wearing it differing visibly from the same face without it, on a Unit and on a Spell.
- No finish covers the art beyond a named opacity, and the signature, cost gem and Unit stats stay readable on a full art wearing each finish.
- The three animated finishes animate on a full-art face in the motion slot, and hold still under reduced motion and with Animated foil off (`cosmetics.test.tsx`).
- A finish on a normal (non-full-art) face looks exactly as it does today.
- The ruling note passes `cargo jackioh spec check`, and `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` passes with the fragment.

## Blocked by, part of

Nothing blocks it. It touches `cosmetics.css` beside #2715; whichever lands second merges main first.
```

# Draft plan for #2720 (planner's notes)

## Findings
- cosmetics.css finishes: lines 205-358. `.cf[data-finish]::before` z4 overlay on root (over everything). Panel finishes
  set --cf-frame (matte, steel, velvet, stained) or paint `.cf-scale` (stained, obsidian, starlit).
- Full art (cards.css 886-953): `.cf-art-frame` inset 0, z0, covers the whole `.cf-scale` panel; scrim is
  `.cf-art-frame::after`. Name banner `.card-name` still uses --cf-frame (z2). cost-gem z3, cf-gem z3, cf-stats z3,
  cf-set z3 (setmark.css), cf-crest z2, cf-signature z2 (cosmetics.css 697), cf-states z4.
- `.cf-scale::before` is used only by `.cf[data-layout="minion"][data-frame]` (minion border ring). A full-art face
  is never minion layout (fullArt.ts showsFullArt; CardFace sets data-full-art only for layout full). So
  `.cf[data-full-art="true"][data-finish] .cf-scale::before` is free: z1 = over art+scrim, under banner/gems/stats/sig.
- core-004 (Gary the Gambler, Common Unit) is a full-art card; vitest & Cypress render it full art by default
  (fullArt setting on, no FullArtOwned => "every"). classicplus-019 League of Losers = Legendary Spell full art.
- Motion: useCosmeticAttributes sets data-cosmetic-motion on full-art faces already; gated rules
  `.cf[data-finish=X][data-cosmetic-motion="animated"]::before` already match full-art faces. No TS change needed.
- Pixel screenshot helper pattern: e2e/cypress/component/deck-cosmetics.cy.tsx (screenshot, pixelAt, changedShare).
- Component specs run daily (super.yml) + typecheck per PR (web-check job: `pnpm --dir e2e typecheck:component`).
- Ruling: R2720000 (first of #2720's block); pending para in spec/pending/2720.md; edit §10.10 (spec/10-engine-guide.md:265).
- Fragment: `cargo jackioh patches "<title>" --visual` (R2529000), JSON in crates/cards/patches/pending/.

## Design
One new layer per full-art face wearing a finish: `.cf-scale::before`, z-index 1, opacity 0.6 (FULL_ART_FINISH_OPACITY,
constants.ts), masked to an edge band fading in (16% sides, 11% top/foot), middle clear. Six panel finishes:
`background: inherit` (their own panel). Linen/parchment/gilded: own paint. Existing rules untouched.

## Status
Writing final plan.
